name: NRE 4665
title: Natural Resources Modeling
description: Applications of conservation of mass, energy and momentum in modeling natural resources systems. Defining systems; determining flows and storages; interactions and feedback mechanisms within systems. Problem oriented course including computer solutions using spreadsheets or modeling programs.
requirement_description: MATH 1120 or higher; open only to Natural Resources majors, others with instructor consent; open to juniors or higher.
